createReport.title: Report a disease
createReport.subtitle: One step at a time — tap next when you are ready.
createReport.pickCategoryFirst: Choose a category first, then the animal type.
createReport.noCategoriesLoaded: Could not load categories. Check your connection and try again.
createReport.noSpeciesInCategory: No animal types are listed for this category yet.
createReport.locationHintShort: Pick country, then governorate, then city if it appears, then village or area — the report needs that last area selected.
createReport.coordsHintShort: Pin coordinates only if you already know them — otherwise you can skip.
createReport.addAnimalFirst: Add an animal first from the home screen.
createReport.headlinePlaceholder: e.g. Calf has a cough and won't nurse
createReport.describeHelper: Every detail helps — even rough notes are fine.
createReport.locationHint: Pick the closest village or area so responders can find you on the map.
createReport.coordsHint: If you know GPS coordinates, add them — otherwise skip.
createReport.reviewHint: Give it a quick read. When you send, your local network gets a gentle heads-up.

validation.pickAnimal: Pick a category and animal type
validation.headline: Add a short headline
validation.describeLength: A bit more detail helps (at least 20 characters)
validation.pickCity: Choose the nearest city to continue.
validation.noCities: No cities are listed for this governorate yet. Try another governorate or ask an admin to update locations.
validation.noRegions: No villages or areas are listed for this city yet. Try another city.
validation.latitudeInvalid: Enter a valid latitude number or leave blank
validation.longitudeInvalid: Enter a valid longitude number or leave blank

createReport.success: Thank you — your report is in caring hands.
